title: DT OG++ CFO oscillator
author: DT OG++
description: CFOO (machine 41), a 3-oscillator 8-bit FM synth: WAV1 FMSR WAV2 WAV3 / MIX FM DET2 DET3 on its SRC page, the waves drawn on WAV1-3, [FUNC] + knob to the pure waves, the four mixes and the detune points, its names as LFO destinations. With dtogpp-portamento, OSC1 glides; with dtogpp-poly, a Poly track plays it on every voice of the pool.

differ.why: OSC1's notes: the mod reads their address from its word cfo_notes (dtogpp-portamento's glided notes, or the stock NOTES), which its render sets each tick; the build's lea names portamento's notes, 0x439d1180, where this check places cfo_notes
the range lookup of ParameterSet::vfunc_25 goes to the mod's cfo_range
the machine-change reset's range lookup goes to the mod's cfo_range
the reset to the default's range lookup goes to the mod's cfo_range4
a MIDI CC's range lookup goes to the mod's cfo_range
the all-tracks edit's range lookup goes to the mod's cfo_range_a3
the encoder's display object (its step) comes from the mod's cfo_encobj
[FUNC] + knob's display object comes from the mod's cfo_fobj
the [TRK] pop-up's text goes through the mod's cfo_trkpop2
the SRC pop-up's text goes through the mod's cfo_srcpop
the SRC title goes through the mod's cfo_srctitle2
knob D's sample test goes to the mod's cfo_samptest
